subject: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
To: audits@novaplace.com, lena.ortiz@novaplace.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery

Lena / NovaPlace audits team,

Following up on our SIG questionnaire, we have one more narrow ask around admin-activity / operator ledger extracts: a partner audit may request short-notice (<=48h) evidence pulls for a bounded window (up to 30 days). We want to confirm the practical export modes you support and any constraints that affect our ability to meet a 48-hour SLA. Specifically: 

- What export formats do you accept for ingestion? (e.g., gzipped CSV manifest + per-shard parquet, Cloud Storage presigned URLs, SFTP with signed manifest)
- Do you require a specific manifest schema / HMAC checksum for attestation?
- Are there limits on sequence/transaction windows we should be aware of (max rows, retention cold tiers)?
- If we need redaction/sampling applied by you, what timeline should we plan for?

Attachments: redaction_matrix.xlsx (our current redaction plan), export_modes_diagram.png (proposed options).

We need to confirm this for the internal runbook and for a possible on-demand export that a customer has asked about. Can you share the ingestion preference and any SLA constraints?

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0192
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaplace.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, audits@novaplace.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a couple of caveats.

1) Formats we support for customer ingestion: 
   - gzipped CSV (row-delimited) with a signed manifest (CSV manifest + SHA256 checksums per file).
   - Parquet bundles (snappy) delivered via pre-signed S3 URLs or Azure SAS tokens.
   - SFTP deposit for larger bundles (we provide account + path; prefer mutual TLS for high-sensitivity).

2) Manifest / attestation: 
   - We require a manifest.csv header with fields: filename, sha256_hex, row_count, start_timestamp, end_timestamp, source_region.
   - We accept either a manifest HMAC signed by the sender or a DocuSign-attested manifest if the customer requires legal chain-of-custody.

3) Limits / performance: 
   - On-demand pulls: small requests (<=500k rows total) — typical turnaround 24-48h. Larger slices (multi-GB parquet) are queued and we provide ETA (usually 3-5 business days).
   - If the data set touches archived/cold-storage tiers, additional retrieval time (up to 48h) may apply.

4) Redaction / sampling: 
   - We can perform token-level redaction server-side (PII patterns) but it requires 24-72h processing depending on volume.
   - Sampling / downsampling for large windows is supported; we provide sampling rules and a signed sampling-manifest.

Attachments: evidence_spec_v1.docx (format + manifest example), sample_manifest.csv (example manifest row).

Notes: please confirm timezone normalization (we prefer UTC timestamps in manifests) and whether you require checksum algorithm other than SHA256.

Regards,

Lena Ortiz
Lead Evidence Operations
NovaPlace Compliance Services
lena.ortiz@novaplace.com
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaplace.com>, audits@novaplace.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery

Lena — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple follow-ups so we can finalize our runbook: 

- We will standardize on UTC timestamps in the manifest.
- For HMAC vs DocuSign: either works for us. For ad-hoc short-notice pulls (48h), HMAC-signed manifest is our preferred path to avoid DocuSign latency; we can DocuSign only for high-stakes legal requests.
- For on-demand small pulls (<=500k rows) we need a commitment of 48h maximum from request acceptance to evidence delivered in presigned URLs. Is that an operational SLA you can accept if we include the request in the subject line as URGENT-AE (ad-hoc evidence)?

Proposed export modes (we'll choose one in the runbook):
1) Presigned S3 upload by Redwood into a dedicated bucket + your ingest job pulls and returns a signed manifest (fastest).
2) SFTP deposit to NovaPlace (preferred for high-sensitivity, slower onboarding).

Kimberly / Vanessa — any constraints on our side I should record in the runbook (access, redaction rules, or pre-approved buckets)?

Thanks,
Michael
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaplace.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery

Michael — quick notes from an ops/compliance perspective:

- Redaction: Redwood will apply pseudonymization for user-identifiable tokens before export unless the customer contract explicitly allows full identifiers. The redaction_matrix.xlsx attached in the first mail lists fields we redact by default.
- Buckets: we can publish presigned upload endpoints to a tenant-scoped S3 bucket; these uploads are single-use and expire within 12 hours.
- Checksums: we will compute SHA256 per shard and include it in our manifest; if NovaPlace requires HMAC with a shared key we can support that (ops will need key-exchange steps).
- Emergency escalation: if a request is marked URGENT-AE we will allocate a dedicated runbook path and triage within 2 hours of receipt; delivery still subject to the 48h extraction window and archive retrieval latencies.

Please include the redaction rules and emergency tag examples in the runbook.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novaplace.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity ledger — export mode selection & short-notice evidence delivery

All — appreciate the clarity. We can accept the URGENT-AE flow with the following binding points: 

- For URGENT-AE small pulls (<=500k rows) we commit to 48h turnaround provided the manifest and presigned upload arrive within business hours and files are not on cold/archived storage.
- Required manifest: sample_manifest.csv schema accepted (UTC timestamps, sha256_hex, row_count). We will provide a signed ingestion receipt and attach a manifest of ingestion checksums.
- For HMAC: we'll provide a short-lived shared key exchange process (via secure keyshare) for customers who prefer HMAC over DocuSign.
- We will provide an escalation matrix and a DocuSign template for chain-of-custody where legal attestation is required; we prefer HMAC for speed.

Next steps: 
1) Michael / Kim — finalize runbook text and redaction appendix; share Drive folder link and we'll review.
2) We'll provision a sample SFTP account for testing (credentials via Vault) and post an ETA for on-boarding (2 business days).
3) We'll add the URGENT-AE SLA clause to our evidence onboarding guide and produce a one-page cheat sheet for your CS / Security teams.

Attachments: ingestion_receipt_template.docx, onboarding_sftp_instructions.pdf, evidence_manifest_sample.csv

I'll schedule a 30-min handoff call for Friday if that works.

Thanks,
Lena
Lead Evidence Operations
NovaPlace Compliance Services
